name: Ghostdesk
description: Builds and tests stock-forecasting models on the S&P 500 as it was on each date, turns the forecasts into risk-limited portfolios, and runs a paper-money desk. Order execution is currently switched off.

name: Pitchvision
description: Reconstructs the football players that a TV broadcast does not show, with an uncertainty region around each one. The model runs in the browser on real Bundesliga clips.

name: Pitwall
description: Predicts lap times, safety cars and overtakes, then simulates the rest of the race many times to compare pit-stop plans. You can replay a past race lap by lap in the browser.
